landing.heroHeadline: Dandali ɗaya. Hanyoyi guda uku don isar wa kowane ɗalibi.

read.encourageBody1: Babu daidai ko kuskure a nan — kowace amsa tana taimakawa wajen fahimtar yadda kake karɓar sabbin abubuwa.
read.encourageBody2: Yawancin masu koyo suna ganin cewa hotuna, sauti, ko aikin hannu suna sa ra'ayoyi su bayyana ta hanyoyi daban-daban. Naka ma daidai ne.

read.completeBody: Mun samu duk abin da muke bukata don gina bayanan koyonka.
